events.title: Spaceman’s Dead Friends

events.title: Darren Criss
events.about: Darren Criss, the singer, songwriter and actor many first got to know on Glee, brings his pop show to the Germantown Performing Arts Center. events.title: Caleb Lee Hutchinson

events.title: Mark Edgar Stuart

events.about: Mark Edgar Stuart, a Memphis Americana songwriter, settles into The Green Room at Crosstown Arts for a Thursday night show. events.title: Bar-Kays
events.about: The Bar-Kays, the Memphis funk and soul band that came up at Stax and broke through with "Soul Finger," play a hometown show at Satellite Music Hall. events.title: SantaRockS Christmas Music Showcase & Performance
events.about: SantaRockS brings its Christmas music showcase to TheatreWorks at the Square, with holiday songs filtered through R&B, soul and jazz. events.title: Salo Pallini: “Some Air” Record Release Show
events.about: Salo Pallini celebrates the release of Some Air with a show in the Crosstown Arts Theater. events.title: Colour Revolt (w/ Unless)

events.title: Germantown Symphony Orchestra: Holiday Concert
events.about: The Germantown Symphony Orchestra's annual holiday concert comes to the Germantown Performing Arts Center, sing-along included. It's a warm, community-minded way to settle into the season close to home.  Saturday, December 12, 2026 · Germantown Performing Arts Center · 7 PM

events.title: Lucero Family Christmas with Son Volt & The Narrows
events.about: Lucero brings its Family Christmas show to Minglewood Hall, putting the Memphis rock band fronted by Ben Nichols on a hometown stage for the holidays. events.title: Music By KOTA
events.about: KOTA, a Memphis indie rock band, plays Tin Roof on Beale Street with a set that pulls from rock, alternative and folk. It's a solid Saturday night pick for anyone already headed downtown.  Saturday, December 12, 2026 · Tin Roof, 315 Beale St · 7 PM

events.title: Wyly Bigger Performs “A Charlie Brown Christmas”
events.about: Memphis musician Wyly Bigger performs A Charlie Brown Christmas at Hernando's Hide-A-Way, bringing Vince Guaraldi's holiday jazz classics to a Sunday matinee. events.title: MYSP Sounds of the Season Concert
events.about: The Memphis Youth Symphony Program presents Sounds of the Season, a holiday concert from the young musicians in its program. events.title: Shell on Wheels: Mekong Festival Reunion
events.venue: Vietnamese Buddhist Association of Memphis, Chùa Chánh Tâm
events.about: Overton Park Shell's Shell on Wheels mobile stage travels to the Mekong Memphis Festival to mark 50 years of community-building alongside Memphis's Southeast Asian neighbors. The festival is a cultural celebration in the Washington Bottoms neighborhood commemorating 50 years since Vietnamese, Laotian, Cambodian, and Thai refugee families began settling along the Cleveland Street corridor in 1975. The all-ages reunion features intergenerational Southeast Asian performances, food, and heritage activities. Event header lists 11 AM to 5 PM; the description says 11 AM to 6 PM.

Sponsors include MEMPHO, Planned Parenthood Tennessee and North Mississippi, Lane Music, Duck Donuts. events.title: Shell on Wheels: ARTSmemphis Green House Party
events.about: Shell on Wheels partners with ARTSmemphis and Overton Park Conservancy for an outdoor music night at the Overton Park Greenhouse with live music, interactive art pop-ups, specialty cocktails, and fire pits. Music Export Memphis presents the Shell on Wheels stage lineup: The Ambassador Access cohort, Raneem Imam and band, Walt Phelan trio, and Alexis Jade. Bertram Williams presents an immersive botanical art installation in the Greenhouse using plants, light, textiles, and staging; hands-on visual art activities with Overton Park Conservancy and the Metal Museum. Food and drink: TOPS food truck, interactive food stations, Alma Del Jaguar Tequila and Duck Club Bourbon cocktails, Busters wine, beer and mocktails from Nutrition Bar. 100% of proceeds support ARTSmemphis and Overton Park Conservancy.
